rule.name: CatchLogWithoutException
rule.message: This log call in a catch leaves the caught exception out, so the stack trace and the cause are lost. SLF4J and Log4j 2 take the exception last (log.warn("could not load '{}'", id, e)); JBoss Logging and Quarkus Log take it first in the formatted forms (log.warnf(e, "could not load %s", id)) and last in log.warn("could not load", e); java.util.logging and System.Logger take log(Level.WARNING, "could not load", e). Name the catch parameter ignored when the failure is expected and needs no trace.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.jboss.logging.BasicLogger') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.quarkus.logging.Log')]] [@MethodName = ('warn', 'error', 'fatal', 'warnf', 'errorf', 'fatalf', 'warnv', 'errorv', 'fatalv', 'warning', 'severe') or (@MethodName = ('log', 'logf', 'logv') and ArgumentList/*[1][self::FieldAccess][@Name = ('WARN', 'WARNING', 'ERROR', 'FATAL', 'SEVERE')])] [let $catch := ancestor::CatchClause[1], $caught := string($catch/CatchParameter/VariableId/@Name), $arguments := ArgumentList/* return exists($catch) and not(matches($caught, '^(?:_|ignore\w*|expected\w*|unused\w*)$', 'i')) and empty(($arguments | $arguments/ArrayInitializer/*)[not(self::NullLiteral)] [(self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught) or (self::CastExpression and *[last()][self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught]) or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Throwable') or (self::ConstructorCall and ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $caught])]) and empty($catch/Block//ThrowStatement[*[1][(self::VariableAccess and @Name = $caught) or (self::ConstructorCall and ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $caught])]])]
